label: LIS3DH Tilt Logger
info: Reads 3-axis acceleration and the relative on-chip temperature from a LIS3DH every 100 ms. A function node computes the magnitude √(x²+y²+z²) plus the pitch and roll angles with atan2(), showing how the total vector stays near 1 g even as the static gravity component shifts between the X, Y and Z axes when the sensor is tilted. The relative die temperature (1 digit/°C, referenced to the power-on value) is included in the payload. Demonstrates continuous tilt/orientation monitoring with a 12-bit (1 mg/LSB) sensor. Adjust the measurement range (±2/±4/±8/±16 g), the output data rate and the operating mode (low-power 8-bit, normal 10-bit, high-resolution 12-bit) in the device config node to match the application's dynamic range and power budget.

name: magnitude + pitch/roll
